messages:
lina: Service embeddings throwing spikes of 5xxs since 03:05 UTC, looks like migration sidecar hang. Need a hotpatch to restart worker and flip MIGRATION_FLAG. Request expedited approvals (SRE + Product). Preferred window 03:30-04:00 UTC. deploybot, intake?

deploybot: Intake acked. Hotpatch proposal image=redwood/embeds:2026.03-hotfix-migA, canary=10% for 4m. Requires approvals: @omar (SRE) + @rachel (Product). Provide runbook and rollback one-liner.

omar: Oncall SRE. Provide quick rollback cmd and abort thresholds. I'll run staging smoke.

lina: Runbook (short): 1) Kick canary 10% for 4m. 2) Monitor errors via /dash?svc=embeds&window=4m and logs for sidecar panics. Abort if errors >1% OR p95 increases >200ms. 3) Rollback: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/embeds embeds=redwood/embeds:2026.03-stable && kubectl rollout status deploy/embeds`. 4) Post release note.

rachel: Product ack - no schema change. Draft release note: "Hotfix: restart embed worker and toggle migration flag to remediate intermittent 5xxs. No API changes."

omar: Staging smoke passed at 03:24 UTC. KV cache warm, healthchecks ok. Approve after canary green.

deploybot: Manual gate created. To approve run `/deploy approve 6555550000 --by @omar` and `/deploy approve 6555550000 --by @rachel`. Start with `/deploy kick 6555550000 --window 03:30-04:00 --manual-gate`.

tim: Ops will watch metrics and open bridge at kick.

lina: Kicking canary 03:31 UTC. Canary id cb-6555550000. Initial canary metrics: errors=0.09%, p95 +25ms.

omar: Canary green from SRE. `/deploy approve 6555550000 --by @omar`

rachel: Approving from Product. `/deploy approve 6555550000 --by @rachel`

deploybot: Approvals received. Promoting to 100% at 03:36 UTC. Rolling update in progress.

deploybot: Rollout complete 03:38 UTC. Post-rollout metrics: errors ~0.08%, p95 within baseline. No rollback executed.

opsbot: Monitoring window +30m active. No regressions observed so far.

lina: Release note posted to internal docs and #release-notes. Closing thread after monitor. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
